sections.heading: What Is Eyelid Lifting Blepharoplasty?
body: Sagging upper eyelids can block your vision and affect daily activities like driving or simply reading notifications on your phone. It’s also hard to determine one’s emotions with baggy or droopy eyelids, since they often lead to looking constantly sad or tired.

Eyelid lifting blepharoplasty can restore clearer peripheral vision and create a younger look for the eyes. This surgical procedure addresses excess tissue on the upper and lower eyelids. It can tighten sagging muscle tissue, tighten or remove excess skin, and remove or reposition excess fat.

sections.heading: Am I a Good Candidate for Eyelid Lifting Blepharoplasty?
body: The best candidates for eyelid lifting blepharoplasty are physically healthy individuals who want to correct their drooping or bulging eyelids. People with medical conditions that can impair healing may experience complications during and after the surgery such as infections and blood clots.
The result of the procedure will vary from person to person, so it is important to have realistic goals for eyelid surgery.

Eyelid lifting produces the best results for non-smokers. Smoking can lead to slower incision healing, so patients must avoid smoking cigarettes or using nicotine devices four to six weeks before and after surgery.

People with dry-eye, hypertension, blood-circulation disorders, thyroid disorders, diabetes, or heart disease are not ideal candidates for eyelid surgery. Undergoing this procedure with any of these medical conditions can put the patient’s health at risk.

sections.heading: WHAT ARE PRP AND PRF INJECTIONS?
body: Therapeutic application of stem cells

At Stone Surgical Arts, we offer platelet-rich plasma (PRP) and platelet-rich fibrin (PRF) injections, two forms of regenerative therapy that restore depleted skin cells using injections of your body’s own growth factors. Both procedures begin with a blood draw followed by the processing of the sample to isolate growth-factor-containing platelets and encourage the development of fibrin, a component that acts as a scaffold for the formation of new cells.

sections.heading: Your PRP Treatment procedure
body: As the first step in a PRP or PRF treatment, you will have a blood draw. The collected blood will be processed to isolate a high concentration of natural growth factors like platelets and fibrin. Once the PRP or PRF solution is ready, the procedure site will be numbed with local anesthesia.
